ids: piece id = index into alphabet.concat(merges.map(m => m[0] + m[1])). English and Hindi tables each have their own id space.

preTokenizer.note: Split text with this regex first; each match is merged on its own. A match with 2+ spaces is an indent chip run (starts of code lines). A single leading space stays glued to the word, like ' cat'.

unknownRule: A character outside the alphabet is one single unknown piece (never merged).

wordMode.note: A word-mode piece is one whole word (letters only) or one punctuation/digit run. Alphabetic words not in `known` are unknown. Punctuation and digits count as known.

menuSizeFigures.honestDisplay: hundreds of thousands, not millions (GloVe 6B lowercased vocabulary is 400,000 words)
